style.name: Y2K aesthetic
style.description: Y2K design revisits the optimistic digital imagery associated with the turn of the millennium. Glossy surfaces, silver accents, bubble shapes, and saturated color evoke an early internet vision of the future.

fonts.heading: Syne
fonts.rationale: Expressive headings and geometric supporting text translate the futuristic mood into an available web pairing.

tips: Choose a small set of nostalgic motifs.
Use silver and gloss as accent materials.
Keep core controls consistent beneath the styling.
